images.filename: Ceremonies - Fort Russel, Fort Sill, and Camp Wadsworth - Secretary Baker at start of great Army transcontinental motor train - NARA - 26422617.jpg
images.caption:
Scope and content:  Original Caption: Secretary Baker at start of great Army transcontinental motor train.  Secretary Baker addressing high officials of the Army and members of the Lincoln Highway Association. after accepting the "zero mile stone" marking the start from Washington, D.C. of the huge Army motor train of 60 cars and over 300 men, for the Pacific coast via the Lincoln Highway.
Photographer: Western Newspaper Union

images.filename: Ceremonies - Fort Russel, Fort Sill, and Camp Wadsworth - Elaborate ceremonies mark the start of Army's greatest motor train - NARA - 26422619.jpg
images.caption:
Scope and content:  Original Caption: Elaborate ceremonies mark the start of Army's greatest motor train.  Scene at the start of the transcontinental motor train, from Washington, D.C., Sec. of War Baker speaking at the dedication exercises before the start, before high Army officials, and members of the Lincoln Highway Assn.  The Sec. has just accepted the "zero mile stone" marking the starting point of the historic trip.
Photographer: Western Newspaper Union
